title: Dissolve Particle Shader Transition Between GLB Models
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements a dissolve-to-particles shader transition between two loaded GLB models: ScatteringSkull.glb and VirtualCity.glb.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 2, 6) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light at (5, 10, 7) with intensity 1.2 and castShadow enabled.
- Background color: #0a0a1a (dark blue-black).
- OrbitControls for camera interaction, damping enabled.
- Load both GLB models using GLTFLoader from Three.js examples CDN. Normalize both models so they fit within a bounding sphere of radius 2 centered at origin. Store references to both loaded model root objects.

PARTICLE SYSTEM:
- After loading both models, sample vertex positions from each model's geometry (traverse all meshes, collect world-space vertex positions). Store up to 50000 particles. If a model has fewer vertices, duplicate/cycle vertices to reach 50000.
- Create a single THREE.Points object with a BufferGeometry containing attributes: position (current), positionA (skull vertices), positionB (city vertices), randomSeed (per-particle random float 0-1).
- Write a custom ShaderMaterial with uniforms: uTransition (float 0-1), uDissolveThreshold (float 0-1), uTime (float), uParticleSize (float, default 2.0), uColorA (vec3, default #e8c170 gold), uColorB (vec3, default #70b8e8 blue).
- Vertex shader: mix positionA and positionB based on uTransition. During transition, particles whose randomSeed < uDissolveThreshold should be displaced outward along a noise-based offset (use sin/cos of seed*time for pseudo-noise), creating a dissolve scatter effect. Particle size should pulse slightly with time.
- Fragment shader: render soft circular particles (discard fragments outside radius 0.5 from gl_PointCoord center). Color interpolates from uColorA to uColorB based on uTransition. Alpha fades based on distance from center for glow effect. Particles mid-dissolve (scattered) should have reduced alpha (0.3-0.6).

TRANSITION LOGIC:
- The transition is driven by a progress value from 0.0 (fully Skull) to 1.0 (fully City).
- Transition has 3 phases: Phase1 (dissolve out, progress 0-0.4): dissolveThreshold ramps from 0 to 1, particles scatter. Phase2 (morph, progress 0.4-0.6): positions morph from A to B while scattered. Phase3 (resolve in, progress 0.6-1.0): dissolveThreshold ramps from 1 back to 0, particles converge to model B.
- The original GLB meshes should be hidden; only the particle system is visible.

USER INTERACTIONS:
- Spacebar: Toggle auto-play of the transition. When auto-playing, progress increments by 0.003 per frame. When progress reaches 1.0, it reverses direction (ping-pong). Default: auto-play OFF.
- Arrow Right: Manually advance progress by +0.02 (clamped to 1.0). Only works when auto-play is OFF.
- Arrow Left: Manually decrease progress by -0.02 (clamped to 0.0). Only works when auto-play is OFF.
- Key 'R': Reset progress to 0.0, auto-play OFF, direction forward.
- Key '1': Set particle color A to red (#ff4444) and color B to green (#44ff44).
- Key '2': Set particle color A to gold (#e8c170) and color B to blue (#70b8e8) (default).
- Key 'S': Toggle particle size between 2.0 (default) and 4.0.
- Mouse click on canvas: spawn a radial shockwave that temporarily pushes nearby particles outward. Track shockwave active state and radius.

HUD / DOM:
- Overlay div at top-left showing: current progress (2 decimal places), current phase name (Dissolve Out / Morph / Resolve In / Complete / Idle), auto-play status (ON/OFF), active model label (Skull when progress<0.5, City when >=0.5), particle count, current color scheme name (Custom or Default).
- A bottom-center div with a styled range slider (input type=range, min=0, max=100, step=1) that reflects and can control the transition progress. Slider updates in real-time during auto-play. Manual slider drag sets progress directly and pauses auto-play.

STATE MANAGEMENT (window.__3D_STATE__):
Expose and continuously update:
- modelsLoaded: boolean, true when both GLBs loaded
- particleCount: number (should be 50000)
- progress: number 0-1 (current transition progress)
- phase: string ('idle'|'dissolve_out'|'morph'|'resolve_in'|'complete')
- autoPlay: boolean
- direction: number (1 for forward, -1 for reverse)
- dissolveThreshold: number 0-1
- particleSize: number
- colorScheme: string ('default'|'custom')
- colorA: {r,g,b} normalized 0-1
- colorB: {r,g,b} normalized 0-1
- activeModel: string ('skull'|'city')
- shockwaveActive: boolean
- elapsedTime: number (seconds since start)
- frameCount: number
- sliderValue: number 0-100
- meshesHidden: boolean (should be true, original GLB meshes hidden)
physics_constraints: Particle positions must always be finite (no NaN/Infinity). Progress must be clamped [0,1]. DissolveThreshold must be clamped [0,1]. Phase must correctly correspond to progress ranges. Slider value must stay synchronized with progress (sliderValue === Math.round(progress*100)). Color values must be normalized [0,1]. Particle count must remain constant throughout transitions.
